description: Changes ONE stored text field of a webinar: the host name, the description, the sales copy, the main headline, the thank-you headline or its sub-headline. Side effect: it writes on the connected WordPress site. The value stands on the pages and in the emails that use it from the next load on; no text is generated and nothing else changes. Needs `session_id`, `webinar_id`, `field` and `value`. Use it when the host wants a field REPLACED as a whole; to change one wording inside a longer text use wi_change_webinar_text with target journey_field, and for the webinar name use wi_change_webinar_title. The host name and the webinar name cannot be emptied, the site refuses that with a plain reason.

confirm.description: Only after the site answered code admin_editing: the host agreed to overwrite unsaved changes in wp-admin.

field.description: Which stored text to replace. One field per call.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

value.description: The new text, verbatim from the host. Never shortened and never invented.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_change_webinar_settings
title: Change one stored text of a webinar
